De-identified: listing id, URL, title, description and photos replaced with fictional values; no seller name, id, phone or profile link kept; address, coordinates and nearby stations are fictional

ground_truth.note: a private seller (buyerItem.seller.isCompany=false): city Москва, two stations, posted_at, views, today_views, params with «Состояние», delivery services, payment on delivery, safe deal, the «Предложить цену» form and seller checks/tenure/reply time; the fictional street address and map point are on the page and must not be returned
